title: Calibrations provided to G6 seem to be modified from what was entered.
symptom: When entering a calibration, the value shown in the transmitter queue was 0.5 mmol/L lower than the value entered. The user verified this with subsequent calibrations, e.g., entered 7.0 mmol/L but the queue showed a lower value.
evidence_quote: I was unable to reproduce the issue reliably and after multiple updates has not shown up again.
